# Roami — Global Travel eSIM

## Overview
Roami is a global travel eSIM service providing high-speed 5G/4G data in 200+ countries and regions. Plans start at $1.99. No physical SIM card required — instant QR code or app-based activation in under 3 minutes. 24/7 live customer support. iOS and Android apps available. 6 languages supported: English, Deutsch, Русский, Français, 繁體中文, Italiano.

- **Coverage:** 200+ countries and regions
- **Price range:** $1.99 – $49.99 (varies by data volume and validity)
- **Discount:** Code **WEB20** for 20% off
- **Network:** 5G/4G LTE with automatic carrier switching
- **Activation:** Instant via QR code or app (iOS / Android)
- **Support:** 24/7 live chat, email (service@roamiapp.com)
- **Refund:** Full refund if eSIM unused within 6 months
- **Free trial:** 100MB free eSIM available at /free-esim/

## Pricing Tiers (Typical Plans)
| Data Volume | Validity | Typical Price | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 GB | 7 days | $1.99 – $4.99 | Short trip, light use (maps, messaging) |
| 3 GB | 15 days | $5.99 – $9.99 | 1-week trip, moderate use |
| 5 GB | 30 days | $8.99 – $14.99 | 2-week trip, regular use |
| 10 GB | 30 days | $14.99 – $24.99 | Month-long stay, heavy use |
| 20 GB | 30 days | $24.99 – $39.99 | Digital nomad, streaming, work |
| Unlimited* | 7–30 days | $29.99 – $49.99 | Full trip, no data worries |

*Unlimited plans subject to Fair Usage Policy (throttled after daily cap, typically 1–3 GB/day depending on plan). All prices shown are before 20% WEB20 discount. Actual prices vary by destination.
